entities.summary: Namibia is a sovereign nation in Southern Africa, Africa. Its capital is Windhoek. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary dominant-party semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 2.6 million. Area: 825,615 km². Comprehensive index for Namibia covering San rock art (Twyfelfontein), Bantu migration, Herero/Nama peoples, German South-West Africa, Herero/Nama genocide (1904–1908, first genocide of the 20th century), South African mandate, SWAPO liberation struggle, independence 1990 (last African colony), and Skeleton Coast.
